THE LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT) ACT
No. 28 OF 1964 ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: EHE/DS/LND/05/ACQ/Village - Ex/02.
Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4/3/15/2013/VE/144.

I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of Land Acquisition Act, No. 28 of 1964 as (Amendment) that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose:
Description of the land to be acquired:

Five allotments of land in total extent of 5.9177 Hectares depicted as Lot No. 46, 47, 48, 49 and 50 in Sheet No. 1, Supplement No. 1 in the Final Village Plan No. 660 dated 20.06.2016 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village called Mitihelagama, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Eheliyagoda in Kuruwita Korale Pallepattuwa in Ratnapura District of Sabaragamuwa Province and more fully described as follows.

01. Lot No. 46 Name of Land: Galamunahenewatta, Kiriathulewatta, Dungasdeniyehenawatta alias Sandarlandwatta; Description: Scrub; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Pussellawa Plantation Company; Extent: 0.0470 Hectare.

02. Lot No. 47 Name of Land: Galamunahenewatta, Kiriathulewatta, Dungasdeniyehenawatta alias Sandarlandwatta; Description: Access Road; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Pussellawa Plantation Company; Extent: 0.1018 Hectare.

03. Lot No. 48 Name of Land: Galamunahenewatta, Kiriathulewatta, Dungasdeniyehenawatta alias Sandarlandwatta; Description: Scrub; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Pussellawa Plantation Company; Extent: 0.3744 Hectare.

04. Lot No. 49 Name of Land: Galamunahenewatta, Kiriathulewatta, Dungasdeniyehenawatta alias Sandarlandwatta; Description: Scrub; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Pussellawa Plantation Company; Extent: 3.6252 Hectares.

05. Lot No. 50 Name of Land: Galamunahenewatta, Kiriathulewatta, Dungasdeniyehenawatta alias Sandarlandwatta; Description: Scrub and open waste land; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Pussellawa Plantation Company; Extent: 1.7693 Hectares.

LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT) ACT No.
28 OF 1964 (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.: EHE/DS/LND/05/ACQ/VRS/03. Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4/3/4/2014/LO/280.

I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of Land Acquisition Act, No. 28 of 1964 as (Amendment) that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose:
Description of the land to be acquired:

An allotment of land, in total extent of about 0.6070 Hectare depicted as Lot 2288 in the Sheet No. 55, Supplement No. 57 of the Final Village Plan No. 219 dated 09.05.2017 prepared by the Survey General situated in the Village called Karandana (part) in Kuruwita Korale Meda Pattuwa Minor Division in the Divisioal Secretary’s Division of Eheliyagoda in Rathnapura District of the Sabaragamuwa Province.
01. Lot No. 2288 Name of Land: Karandana watta; Description: A Rubber Plantation of about 20-30 years old; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Balangoda Plantation Company; Extent: 0.6070 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby required to appear Personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat, Eheliyagoda, on 24th October, 2017 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 16th October, 2017 the nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
All deeds and documents in support of the claims should be produced before me at the inquiry.
R. H. S. DISSANAYAKE, Divisional Secretary, Eheliyagoda.
Divisional Secretariat, Eheliyagoda, 22nd August, 2017. 09-149
NOTICE OF AMENDMENT
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: NCP/MG/LO2/General/07-04. Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: 4/3/9/2010/IR/06 dated

I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the under mentioned lands which are required for the purpose of construction of the Medirigiriya Kantale Road under the Moragahakanda, Kaluganga Development Project.
Description of the lands to be acquired:

The allotments of land described below as shown in the Plan in the Sheet No. 03 in the Zone No. 11 in the C. P. No. 120056 of the Surveyor General located in the Village of Bisobandaragama in the No. 100 Bisobandaragama in the Minor Division of Sinhala Pattuwa in the Medirigiriya Divisional Secretary’s Division in the District of Polonnaruwa in the North Central Province.
01. Lot No. 169 Name of Land: MedirigiriyaYaya, open waste land; Claimant: Government, (Encroacher, Kasthuri Arachchige Douglas Vijaya Kumara of Diggalpura); Extent: 0.0098 Hectare.
